hypothesis: At first foot-only collision, ball minus contacting foot lateral center is a useful physical predictor of 60-frame lateral ball displacement.
training: Audited independent acquisition banks v278 and v279, seeds 20260953-56; train only foot-only contacts, both action arms.
test_procedure: New independent SONIC parents and paired acquisition arms with source/asset/actor frozen; no model refit on test episodes.
model: Ordinary least-squares lateral_60_m = intercept + slope * measured ball-minus-contacting-foot y at first contact; dominant measured foot force chooses side if both feet contact.
test_gate: At least 8 clean foot-only test episodes, held-out mean absolute lateral error <=0.30 m and at least 30% lower than the frozen training-mean predictor. Otherwise reject mechanism as insufficiently predictive.
